headline: OpenAI hires ex-Army Secretary as AI security warnings mount
body: Security stories dominated. OpenAI hired former US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll for a national security role, the day's largest single push to Catastrophic Risk. The UK's NCSC said an AI-powered ransomware attack on UK critical infrastructure is 'highly likely' by 2028, and Binance said its $6.3 billion theft began with a fake job interview and hijacked internal AI tools. Together Catastrophic Risk rose 0.33. On the other side, Ibero-American countries formed an AI Alliance in Madrid, lifting Global Coordination, and a Brazilian court barred Meta from training AI on news content without permission, easing Power Concentration. Self-Destruction was the biggest mover; Libertarian Utopia fell. Horizon Balance fell to -10.24 from -10.07.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.3, mostly from OpenAI's Driscoll hire (+0.19) and the NCSC ransomware warning (+0.11), partly offset by the Ibero-American AI Alliance (-0.05) and smaller items (-0.04). Reversion +0.2, mostly from OpenAI's Driscoll hire (+0.07) and fading earlier news (+0.05). Libertarian Utopia -0.1, mostly from OpenAI's Driscoll hire (-0.09) and the NCSC ransomware warning (-0.05), partly offset by the Brazil Meta ruling (+0.05) and smaller items (+0.03).
